title: Unquiet
summary: UNQUIET, adjective 1. Not quiet; not calm or tranquil; restless; uneasy; as an unquiet person; an unquiet mind. 2. Agitated; disturbed by continual motion; as the unquiet ocean. 3. Unsatisfied; restle

inlines.v: UNQUIET, adjective 1. Not quiet; not calm or tranquil; restless; uneasy; as an unquiet person; an unquiet mind. 2. Agitated; disturbed by continual motion; as the unquiet ocean. 3. Unsatisfied; restless. UNQUI'ET, verb transitive To disquiet. [Not in use.]
